members.name: encodePool
members.summary:
Shared TASM encode worker pool: multiple entries (and multiple
`LynxEncodePlugin` instances in the same process) share its worker
slots for parallel encode; watch-mode rebuilds keep the same workers
warm. `availableParallelism()` honors cgroup CPU limits (containers,
CI runners), so we don't need to subtract a core ourselves.

members.summary: Convert the css chunks to css map.
members.remarks:
This helper currently forwards to `cssChunksToMap`.

The returned `cssSource` is keyed by `cssId` and uses the synthetic
filename format `/cssId/<id>.css`.

This helper does not remap generated `loc` fields to original source
coordinates.

it.

members.name: customSectionNaming
members.summary: Assemble every chunk into a custom section, named by this strategy.
members.remarks:
A bundle assembled this way carries no `lepusCode`, and only the chunks
left unnamed stay in the manifest. A `FetchBundle` lazy bundle is assembled
this way by default, under the three section names its runtime resolves.
